settings.description: Mandatory dense real-project baseline used for the hybrid rendering work.
notes: This fixture is a checked-in snapshot of the settings project so benchmark reruns do not depend on ad hoc runtime state.

tier1Synthetic.description: Deterministic synthetic canvas covering the repeated Tier 1 dense param section families.
notes: Should include representative repeated counts for Callable, Dict, param-heavy dict variants, list/object-style param sections, and GlobalVariables when it shares the same body stack.

tier2Synthetic.description: Deterministic synthetic canvas covering Tier 2 code/editor section families.
notes: Prompt and TextBlock belong here only for their editor-side CodeMirror path, not for their restored outer layout shell.

tier1Tier2CombinedSynthetic.description: Deterministic mixed canvas used once both heavy families have dedicated scenes.
notes: Should preserve deterministic section IDs, positions, and sizes so the same CDP replay remains valid across main and worktree runs.
